memory.content: Lesson films are matplotlib Agg plus numpy. Rejected approach: Imagine stills plus zoompan or Ken Burns. Motion is parameter interpolation and a redraw of the same artists. Points are never regenerated or jittered.
Voice is Eve TTS. No music. Two-pass loudnorm to -16 LUFS. Each scene is speech duration plus a short hold. Picture and sentence are the same object.
